description:
## Why

PKIX-lhm4 acceptance lists "Roundtrip tests against at least three real-world
distro CA bundles (Debian, Alpine, Fedora)". The initial PR shipped only the
Debian fixture (`tests/fixtures/debian-ca-certificates.crt`) because the dev
environment did not have offline access to Alpine `ca-certificates.crt` or
Fedora `ca-bundle.crt`. Per the project's no-fabrication policy, the missing
fixtures were filed here rather than synthesised.

## What

Add the following fixtures under `pkix-truststore/tests/fixtures/`:

- `alpine-ca-certificates.crt` — copied from a current Alpine `ca-certificates`
  package output of `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt`.
- `fedora-ca-bundle.crt` — copied from a current Fedora `ca-certificates`
  package output of `/etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt`.

Extend `tests/fixtures.rs` with `alpine_bundle_loads` and `fedora_bundle_loads`
tests that mirror `debian_bundle_loads`. Update the fixture-creation oracle
constants from a fresh `grep -c BEGIN CERTIFICATE`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Both fixtures committed.
- [ ] Both tests pass.
- [ ] Provenance recorded in `tests/fixtures.rs` module-level doc (which
      distro version, when fetched, what package supplied the bundle).
title: pkix-truststore: add Alpine and Fedora ca-bundle fixtures
